description.value: Hofstede's Country Barn is a well-established farm market in Chilliwack offering locally sourced produce from Okanagan growers, a full deli with nitrate-free meats and cheeses, and an in-house bakery turning out fresh buns, breads, and pastries daily. The on-site cafe serves hot sandwiches, salads, and rotating homemade soups, making it a genuine resupply destination in the Fraser Valley rather than a convenience stop. The store also stocks a broad selection of European specialty groceries, organic items, and gluten-free products.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active farm market with bakery, deli, cafe, and grocery sections. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (45796 Luckakuck Way, Chilliwack, BC V2R 5P9) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The cafe page explicitly lists hot food items (Curried Apple Panini, soups, salads), and the main page confirms a wide grocery inventory including produce, deli meats, and specialty items. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 824-1192 sourced from website contact page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-stocked farm market with deli, bakery, and cafe providing hot food and a broad grocery selection — strong resupply value for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack area of the Fraser Valley.

Hot food.detail: Cafe page lists hot items including Curried Apple Panini, Raw Power Salad, and four homemade soups of the day, available for in-store pickup or delivery

wow_evidence: full deli with nitrate-free meats and cheeses, and an in-house bakery turning out fresh buns, breads, and pastries daily
